description: This file defines functions and types related to heartbeat summaries and configuration within the openclaw project, including enabling/disabling heartbeats, resolving intervals, and generating summaries for agents.

methods.name: hasExplicitHeartbeatAgents
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has agents with explicit heartbeat settings.

methods.name: isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent
methods.description: Determines if heartbeat is enabled for a specific agent based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatIntervalMs
methods.description: Calculates the heartbeat interval in milliseconds based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatSummaryForAgent
methods.description: Generates a summary object for an agent's heartbeat configuration.
